name: mikiui-runtime
description: Frontend runtime bundling for MikiUI (HTMX + Alpine.js + optional Tailwind/DaisyUI).

scripts.tailwind:config: python -c "from mikiui.build.tailwind import write_tailwind_config; import json,sys; opts=json.loads(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else '{}'); print(write_tailwind_config('tailwind.config.js', **opts))"
